title: RideLink Mileage Reimbursement Terms by Level of Service
content:
These are the member reimbursement terms of Non-Emergency Medical Transportation for miles a member's household drives, and the filing and payment periods that apply to member reimbursement claims, set out for each RideLink level of service.

| Level | Standard mileage rate (USD per approved mile) | How approved miles are measured | Trip must be registered with a trip number before the appointment | Claim filing period (calendar days after the trip date) | Payment period (calendar days after approval) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | 0.00 | Not applicable | No | 0 | 0 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | 0.21 | Shortest driving route | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | 0.00 | Not applicable | No | 90 | 30 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | 0.00 | Not applicable | No | 90 | 30 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 0.00 | Not applicable | No | 0 | 0 |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 0.00 | Not applicable | No | 0 | 0 |

A figure of 0 in the filing or payment columns means no filing or payment period is set for that level.

## Points of reading

- RideLink Mileage Reimbursement is the only level with a mileage rate above zero, 0.21 USD per approved mile, measured by the shortest driving route, and the only level that requires the trip to be registered with a trip number before the appointment.
- RideLink Ambulatory Sedan and RideLink Door-to-Door Assist carry no mileage rate, yet list a 90-day filing period and a 30-day payment period for member reimbursement claims.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on RideLink Mileage Reimbursement, 40.0 approved miles at the standard rate of 0.21 USD a mile come to 8.40 USD.
